title: Complanatuside A ameliorates 2,4,6-trinitrobenzene sulfonic acid-induced colitis in mice by regulating the Th17/Treg balance via the JAK2/STAT3 signaling pathway.
authors: Wang, Yueyue; Song, Xue; Xia, Yongsheng; Zhang, Wenjing; Li, Wenjie; Wang, Yu; Li, Jing; Geng, Zhijun; Zhang, Xiaofeng; Wang, Lian; Zuo, Lugen; Hu, Jianguo
journal: FASEB journal : official publication of the Federation of American Societies for Experimental Biology
one_liner_zh: 研究黄酮苷CA通过JAK2/STAT3通路调节Th17/Treg平衡缓解小鼠结肠炎，仅涉及小分子-蛋白对接，无蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Immunity imbalance of T helper 17 (Th17)/regulatory T (Treg) cells is involved in the pathogenesis of Crohn's disease (CD). Complanatuside A (CA), a flavonol glycoside, exerts anti-inflammatory activities and our study aimed to identify its effect on TNBS-induced colitis and the possible mechanisms. We found that CA alleviated the symptoms of colitis in TNBS mice, as demonstrated by prevented weight loss and colon length shortening, as well as decreased disease activity index scores, inflammatory scores, and levels of proinflammatory factors. Flow cytometry analysis showed that CA markedly reduced the percentage of Th17 cells while increasing the percentage of Treg cells in TNBS mice. Under Th17 cell polarizing conditions, CA inhibited the differentiation of Th17 cells while the Treg cell differentiation was elevated under Treg cell polarizing conditions. Furthermore, it was observed that JAK2 interacted with CA through six hydrogen bonds via molecular docking. The phosphorylation of JAK2/STAT3 was reduced by CA, which might be correlated with the protective effect of CA on colitis. In conclusion, CA reduced the imbalance of Th17/Treg cells by inhibiting the JAK2/STAT3 signaling pathway in TNBS-induced colitis, which may provide novel strategies for CD treatment.
abstract_zh: T辅助17（Th17）/调节性T（Treg）细胞免疫失衡参与克罗恩病（CD）的发病机制。沙苑子苷A（CA）是一种黄酮醇糖苷，具有抗炎活性，本研究旨在探讨其对TNBS诱导结肠炎的作用及可能机制。我们发现CA缓解了TNBS小鼠结肠炎症状，表现为防止体重下降和结肠长度缩短，以及降低疾病活动指数评分、炎症评分和促炎因子水平。流式细胞术分析显示，CA显著降低了TNBS小鼠中Th17细胞的比例，同时增加了Treg细胞的比例。在Th17细胞极化条件下，CA抑制了Th17细胞分化，而在Treg细胞极化条件下，Treg细胞分化升高。此外，通过分子对接观察到JAK2与CA通过六个氢键相互作用。CA降低了JAK2/STAT3的磷酸化，这可能与CA对结肠炎的保护作用相关。总之，CA通过抑制JAK2/STAT3信号通路减轻了TNBS诱导结肠炎中Th17/Treg细胞的失衡，这可能为CD治疗提供新策略。
